scenario_description: A reviewed empty copy registry remains open when no markers or records exist.
expected: The gate finds no unresolved record or marker.
The result states that undeclared copies without markers need similarity scanning.
observed: The current registry contains zero copied/adapted records and the source tree contains zero derived-code attribution markers.
The gate reported issue_count 0 and gate_allows_copy true for the no-copy baseline.
The probe retained its warning that marker-free undeclared copying still requires the separate similarity scan.
notes: Manual positive-control review confirms that an intentionally empty registry is not rejected when the audited tree has no declared copies.
